name: Pixelizer – Images
description: Create images with the connected image providers, with reference images and a gallery.
long_description: Creates images with the image providers connected in OmniWrench (Settings > AI assistants): OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, Black Forest Labs, fal.ai, Replicate, Stability AI, Ideogram, Recraft, MiniMax and local ComfyUI/LocalAI. Optionally with up to four reference images. The gallery shows the images of the AI data storage; images can be copied, opened, deleted or attached to the chat panel.
author: KuroShiro
